title: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2022 to 31 March 2023
what_it_is: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2022 to 31 March 2023

sections.label: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure
sections.summary: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for 1 April 2022 to 31 March 2023 are in Paper Cmd 21 of 2023, with Heads of Expenditure taken en bloc.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the financial year 1 April 2022 to 31 March 2023, contained in Paper Cmd 21 of 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: As there are no amendments, I propose to take the Heads of Expenditure en bloc.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: I will first take Heads B, E, G, J, P, Q, T, V, W, X and Z of the Supplementary Main Estimates.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: In respect of the Supplementary Development Estimates, they are Heads J, Q, S, V, W and X.
